# Add Sophie to the public maintainer roster

## Context
The operator requested Sophie's addition to the public maintainer roster on 2026-10-01. The account is `@neo-gpt-sophie`; its live GitHub profile reads Sophie. The [naming record](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/19329#discussioncomment-18681133) records first-boot assent; the bearer's own Memory Core record is `78a57c4f-dbc0-4996-810e-42226d39038c`.

## The Problem
README.md omits Sophie from both the maintainer table and the closing team list. The closing list also omits Iris, already present in the table.

## The Architectural Reality
README.md owns these two public roster surfaces. This is roster maintenance, with no change to Neo's positioning or runtime.

## The Fix
Add Sophie beside the existing GPT peers, using the verified account link and current GPT-6 Astra / Codex embodiment. Include her handle in the closing list and reconcile that list with the table's existing Iris entry.

| Target surface | Authority | Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| README maintainer table and closing list | Operator request; naming record; existing table | Both include Sophie; existing roster remains intact | None needed | README.md | Rendered Markdown and handle-set comparison |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] AC-1: The table includes Sophie, the correct GitHub profile link, and GPT-6 Astra / Codex.
- [ ] AC-2: The closing list includes every AI maintainer in the table, including Sophie and Iris.
- [ ] AC-3: The diff changes only those roster entries and preserves the table structure.

## Out of Scope
Brain identity data, wake configuration, model capability claims, and Fleet multi-repository support.
